references.text: Rahab is first introduced when the spies come to her house in Jericho
Rahab receives a promise that her family will be spared when Jericho is captured
The instructions that Rahab's family must gather in her house to be saved
Joshua's command that Rahab and everyone in her house shall be spared
Joshua sends the two spies to bring back Rahab and her family
Rahab was spared and lived among Israel because she hid the spies
The Letter to the Hebrews mentions Rahab's faith as the reason she did not perish with the unbelievers
James mentions Rahab as an example of justification by works when she welcomed the spies
Rahab is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy as the mother of Boaz
